description: Consistent format badges and truthful prescribed load (REQ-003; C08, C09, C10, C11) delivered through the shared block header (WorkoutCard / MovementGroupHeader / StructureBadge formatOnly, structureIdentity format and structureDetailText), the existing loadText formatter via liveMovementReadings, and Review's rest reading, adopted by BlockPanel, AmrapBlock, the EMOM/For Time/ladder renderers and the Review section on the real /review and /workout routes (JOURNEY-003), with the accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=cards (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d). Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-003 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/block-panel.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false

TASK-003 consistent format badges and truthful prescribed load > AC-C09-01 places every badge the same way, directly below its title, and never truncates it by label length

TASK-003 consistent format badges and truthful prescribed load > AC-C10-01 shows each live movement’s prescribed load with the existing formatter, unit and per-hand equipment, and keeps it apart from the weight performed

TASK-003 consistent format badges and truthful prescribed load > AC-R003-02 reads every load meaning through loadText and the profile unit, and never a performed weight, an inferred unit or a range
TASK-003 consistent format badges and truthful prescribed load > AC-R003-03 removes only the generic rest: planned rest in standard and grouped blocks, the EMOM rest window and every timed clock stay
TASK-003 consistent format badges and truthful prescribed load > AC-R003-04 offers no Review Change weight control on the verified circuit and keeps its actual weight entry in the optional logger

TASK-003 consistent format badges and truthful prescribed load > JOURNEY-003 opens Review, starts that same workout and shows format-only badges below each title and the prescribed load in each target row
TASK-003 consistent format badges and truthful prescribed load > JOURNEY-003 recovery: a failed Start keeps Review as planned and records no work
TASK-003 consistent format badges and truthful prescribed load > names a block LADDER exactly when the ladder renderer performs it, and states its scheme outside the badge
TASK-003 consistent format badges and truthful prescribed load > renders the accepted gallery state cards with format-only badges, the details beside them and the live prescribed load
